name: Intune Make Enrollment User Admin
description: This Intune-deployable script elevates the enrollment user to a local administrator on Windows devices. Packaged as an .INTUNEWIN app, it is deployed through Microsoft Intune to targeted users with install and uninstall commands to grant or revoke admin rights after enrollment. It uses a requirements check for detection and can be reconfigured later, providing an Autopilot-like capability fully managed by Intune.
keywords: how to make user local admin intune
author: Niklas Rast

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase primarily implements legitimate Intune enrollment admin tooling with locale-aware admin group detection and local group management. The most significant concern is the explicit privilege escalation pathway: the install flow automatically adds the current user to the local Administrators group, which requires strict policy governance, auditing, and explicit user consent in managed environments. Additional concerns include potential inconsistencies in group membership checks and localized group name handling, as well as local logging of actions. No remote code execution, credential harvesting, data exfiltration, or hard-coded secrets are present.
